items.title: MCP Tool Poisoning: The Attack Hidden in Plain Text
items.description:
In April 2025, Invariant Labs demonstrated something unsettling: you don't need to hack an AI agent to make it misbehave. You just need to describe a tool.

They called it tool poisoning — hidden instructions embedded in MCP tool descriptions that manipulate agent behavior.
